title: Admin 共用元件重構 — extract shared patterns from existing pages
content:
Admin components already exist under src/components/admin/ (10 files: AdminDictContext, CourseForm, EnrolmentRow, EnrolmentMemberRow, EnrolmentFilters, EnrolmentPagination, RejectDialog, PaymentProofPreview, types, constants). This card extracts shared patterns still duplicated inline across pages.

## Patterns still duplicated (targets for extraction):

### 1. `AdminDataTable` — generic table shell
- Loading skeleton, error state with retry, empty state message — duplicated in courses/page.tsx and enrolments/page.tsx and admin/page.tsx
- Props: `loading`, `error`, `onRetry`, `emptyMessage`, `columns`, `rows`, `keyExtractor`
- Wraps the consistent `<section>` + `<div className="overflow-x-auto">` + `<table>` structure

### 2. `AdminStatCard` — dashboard stat card
- Inline card pattern in admin/page.tsx (icon, label, value, trend arrow) duplicated 4 times
- Props: `icon`, `label`, `value`, `trend?`, `trendUp?`

### 3. `AdminPageHeader` — page title + breadcrumbs + CTA
- Page header with back button, title, and optional CTA button — duplicated across courses/new, courses/[id]/edit, enrolments, courses list
- Props: `title`, `backHref?`, `cta?` (ReactNode for action button)

### 4. `ConfirmActionDialog` — generic confirm dialog
- Dialog with title, description, confirm/cancel buttons — duplicated as inline code in courses/page.tsx (delete dialog) and enrolments (RejectDialog.tsx is similar but specific)
- Make RejectDialog extend a shared base confirm dialog

### 5. `AdminFilterTabs` — configurable filter tab group
- EnrolmentFilters.tsx is hardcoded to payment statuses — generalize to accept array of `{ label, value, count? }`

**Note**: `AdminFilterBar` (search + filters) and `AdminBatchToolbar` proposed earlier have been moved to AD-006 scope since they are functional features, not pure refactoring.

Pure refactoring — no behavior change. Can work in parallel with AD-006 but should coordinate on DataTable and FilterTabs if both touch same files.
refs: src/app/[locale]/admin/courses/page.tsx (inline table shell, inline delete dialog)
src/components/admin/RejectDialog.tsx (refactor to use shared ConfirmActionDialog base)

evidence.residual: AD-006 will also add search/batch UI — coordinate on DataTable shell and FilterTabs if both touch same files.
